extDesc.message: Fill the current tab's video into the browser window (web fullscreen), or make the browser go fullscreen with the video filling the screen. For sites whose built-in web fullscreen is broken.

cmdWebDesc.message: Web fullscreen: video fills the current window

cmdFullDesc.message: Fullscreen: browser enters fullscreen and the video fills it

unsupported.message: Cannot run on this page (browser internal pages and the Web Store are not supported).

statusNoVideo.message: No video found on this page (it may be inside an embedded frame — you can still try)

statusExit.message: Press Esc or click the button again to exit

btnWebSub.message: Video fills the window; the browser stays windowed

btnFullSub.message: The browser enters fullscreen and the video fills the screen

optNative.message: Show native controls (when targeting the video directly)

optFill.message: Stretch to fill the window (may distort)

hintShortcuts.message: Shortcuts are unbound by default — set them at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

hintEsc.message: Web fullscreen / Fullscreen · Press Esc in the page to exit
